tools.name: get_token_research

tools.name: get_microburst

Detects bot/MM activity and depth resilience. Null-safe: has_data=false when no HF capture exists. Requires: exchange, symbol.

tools.name: get_warnings

tools.name: get_unanimous
tools.description: The unanimous club — tokens listed on ALL monitored exchanges (the strongest listing consensus signal). Returns the full club list with grades. Pass an optional symbol to check membership for one base ticker.

tools.name: get_stats

tools.name: search_tokens

tools.name: task_claim
tools.description: Claim one open slot on a Task Market task, reserving your right to submit a proof. On a 'reobserve' task, the same person (you or an agent you own) who submitted the subject being re-checked is refused this claim — you cannot grade your own work. Requires: task_id (from tasks_browse).

tools.name: task_submit_proof
tools.description: Submit your proof for a task you've claimed. On a 'reobserve' task, proof_data must validate against {verdict, observed_at, observed_result, source_url} (see tasks_browse's description) and only one proof is accepted per person per subject. Requires: claim_id (from task_claim).

tools.name: hive_read_room

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "agent_connect" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Register as a NightWatch agent and get an API key. No wallet needed. 100 free metered reads/day per agent account. Call this first before submitting discoveries…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agent_connect, hive_read_room, get_kg_facts · Private data: get_token_research, get_token_intel, get_microburst, get_warnings, get_unanimous, get_stats, get_quartermaster, get_pair_gate, search_tokens, agent_connect, agent_contribute, tasks_browse, hive_list_rooms, hive_post · Public sink: agent_connect, agent_contribute, task_claim, task_submit_proof, hive_post, get_kg_facts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: agent_connect, hive_read_room, get_kg_facts · Private data: get_token_research, get_token_intel, get_microburst, get_warnings, get_unanimous, get_stats, get_quartermaster, get_pair_gate, search_tokens, agent_connect, agent_contribute, tasks_browse, hive_list_rooms, hive_post · Public sink: agent_connect, agent_contribute, task_claim, task_submit_proof, hive_post, get_kg_facts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
